how: Opened the public ChatGPT share page and clicked the site's own "Copy response" button under the longest assistant answer (deeply nested lists with emoji).
notes: Same turn as the selection fixture of the same name (recaptured with the answer index pinned). Copy-button capture. The site writes through navigator.clipboard.write, so there is no org.chromium.source-url. text/plain is the answer as markdown source (pipe tables, ``` fences, $...$ / $$...$$ math, hard line breaks as a trailing backslash); text/html is the app's rendered DOM full of <!--[--> hydration comments, wrapped in <html><head></head><body>, with no inline styles. WARNING: this copy-button capture and chatgpt/nested-lists-emoji-selection are DIFFERENT assistant turns of the same conversation (button: the turn starting 'Understood.'; selection: the one starting 'Below is the holistic...'); the headless run could not be repeated (see README). Deeply nested bullets/numbered lists and emoji.
